'''Yobcrabs''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Crab/Legends|crab]] native to the [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. They occupied the same ecological niche as the [[Yobshrimp/Legends|yobshrimp]], another species of [[Crustacean/Legends|crustacean]] with whom they competed. The crabs could be distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|blue]] shells and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They also possessed eight [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]<ref name="Wild" /> similar to the legs of a [[Droideka/Legends|Droideka]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]],<ref name="TCW">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> the front two of which were claws. Residing on the submerged swamp floors, the yobcrabs fed on [[Fish/Legends|fish]] such as [[Mee/Legends|daggerts]], but were in turn eaten by [[Blarth/Legends|Blarths]]. During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] the [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]] [[Lyrre T'enna]] observed yobcrabs in their natural environment. The notes and sketches [[Gender/Legends|she]] made of the crustaceans were then included in her [[Lyrre T'enna's annotated field guide|annotated field guide]].<ref name="Wild" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yobcrabs first appeared in [[2001]] in ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'', a reference book written by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] and [[Bob Carrau]], with Whitlatch also providing illustrations. They later received mention in [[Karen Traviss]]' [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelisation]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] movie released in [[2006]].
